body.p: Before you troubleshoot, make sure that all of the following are true:

ul.li: The printer can complete a normal PLA print start sequence.
A basic PLA slicing profile is already selected.
Basic bed leveling or first-layer calibration has already been completed.
No obvious hardware fault is present.

body.p: The printer should already be operational. For setup, repair, or service procedures, follow the manufacturer's documentation.
